blocks.text: Muse Spark Open 是 Meta 推出的开放权重模型，已在 Fireworks 上 Day-0 上线。它是一个 816B 参数的混合专家模型，每个 token 激活 42B 参数，上下文窗口为 1M token，专为长周期编程和需要在超长会话中保持连贯的智能体工作而构建。

inlines.text: Muse Spark Open
是 Meta 推出的开放权重模型，已在 Fireworks 上 Day-0 上线。它是一个 816B 参数的混合专家模型，每个 token 激活 42B 参数，上下文窗口为 1M token，专为长周期编程和需要在超长会话中保持连贯的智能体工作而构建。

blocks.text: 它是迄今为止能力最强的美国开放权重模型之一，也是我们在受监管专业工作中见过的最强开放权重模型。它在 Vals AI 的 Harvey 法律智能体基准排行榜上排名第一，通过率接近 Claude Opus 5 的 4 倍。在 Rogo 的 Big Finance Bench 上，它在每个难度级别都击败了 Claude Opus 5.5，并在最难的任务上险胜 GPT-6 Astra。

blocks.text: Muse Spark Open 在美国训练和开发，Fireworks 默认以零数据保留方式运行它。今天就可以在无服务器服务上试用，仅使用美国境内算力，且不收取美国溢价。之后可迁移到预留吞吐量用于生产，并通过无服务器 LoRA 训练对其进行微调。

blocks.text: 在 Rogo，我们会让每个新模型都跑一遍 Big Finance Bench，这是我们由 928 个真实金融工作流问题组成的测试集。Muse Spark Open 得分 53.3%，是我们榜单上排名最高的开放权重模型，甚至领先于前沿的 Claude Opus 5（49.2%）。高性能美国开放权重模型的出现尤其令人兴奋。它们为持续实验提供了基础，也让我们能够针对金融工作的特定需求定制智能。我们对于在推动模型性能前沿的同时为客户释放新水平的价值和效率感到兴奋。——Alex Wang，Rogo 技术员工

blocks.text: 在开放端点之前，我们在生产服务栈上使用发布验证套件对最终开放权重进行了测试。Muse Spark Open 在 AIME26 上得分 91.1%，在 GPQA Diamond 上得分 89.7%，在 SWE-bench Verified 上得分 84.3%，并在 OCRBench 和 MMMU Pro 的图像理解上保持在 80% 以上（图 3）。作为验证，我们还在广泛使用的开源推理引擎 SGLang 上运行了相同的权重，得分一致。你在 Fireworks 上调用的模型，其表现与 Meta 构建时一致。

blocks.text: Muse Spark Open, an open weights model from Meta, is available Day-0 on Fireworks. It's an 816B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 42B parameters active per token and a 1M-token context window, built for long-horizon coding and agent work that has to stay coherent across very long sessions.

inlines.text: Muse Spark Open

, an open weights model from Meta, is available Day-0 on Fireworks. It's an 816B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 42B parameters active per token and a 1M-token context window, built for long-horizon coding and agent work that has to stay coherent across very long sessions.

blocks.text: It’s one of the most capable US open weights model to date, and the strongest open weights model we’ve seen for regulated professional work. It ranks first on Vals AI’s leaderboard for Harvey’s Legal Agent Benchmark, with nearly 4x the pass rate of Claude Opus 5. On Rogo’s Big Finance Bench, it beat Claude Opus 5.5 at every difficulty level and edged out GPT-6 Astra on the hardest tasks.

blocks.text: Muse Spark Open was trained and developed in the US, and Fireworks runs it with Zero Data Retention by default. Try it today on serverless, running on US-only capacity with no US premium. Then move to reserved throughput for production and fine-tune it with serverless LoRA training.

blocks.text: At Rogo we run every new model through Big Finance Bench, our set of 928 real financial workflow questions. Muse Spark Open scored 53.3%, the top open weights model on our board and ahead of even frontier Claude Opus 5 at 49.2%. The emergence of high-performing American open weights models is particularly exciting. They provide a foundation for continued experimentation and the ability to tailor intelligence to the specific demands of financial work. We are excited by the potential to push the frontier of model performance while unlocking new levels of value and efficiency for our customers. - Alex Wang, Member of Technical Staff at Rogo

blocks.text: Before opening the endpoint, we ran the final open weights through our launch validation suite on our production serving stack. Muse Spark Open scored 91.1% on AIME26, 89.7% on GPQA Diamond, and 84.3% on SWE-bench Verified, and stayed above 80% on image understanding with OCRBench and MMMU Pro (Figure 3). As a check, we also ran the same weights on SGLang, a widely used open-source inference engine, and the scores matched. The model you call on Fireworks performs the way Meta built it.

inlines.text: Before opening the endpoint, we ran the final open weights through our launch validation suite on our production serving stack. Muse Spark Open scored 91.1% on AIME26, 89.7% on GPQA Diamond, and 84.3% on SWE-bench Verified, and stayed above 80% on image understanding with OCRBench and MMMU Pro (Figure 3). As a check, we also ran the same weights on SGLang, a widely used open-source inference engine, and the scores matched. The model you call on Fireworks performs the way Meta built it.
